questions.question_text: What is the standard minimum percentage required in the graduation degree to be eligible for the PEEF Master's level scholarship?
questions.explanation: According to the standard PEEF criteria for Master's scholarships, a candidate must have secured at least 60% marks in their graduation.

questions.question_text: If a student has secured a 'Supplementary' in any part of their academic career, are they eligible for the PEEF Master's scholarship?
options: Yes, if passed in the second attempt
No, the student must have passed all exams in the first attempt
Yes, provided the overall GPA is above 3.5
Only if the supplement was in a minor subject
questions.explanation: PEEF mandates that students must have passed their previous academic examinations in the first attempt to maintain eligibility.

questions.question_text: To be eligible for PEEF Master's level scholarship, an applicant must have passed their graduation examination as a regular student in which session?
options: Current academic year only
Within the last three years
Any year provided they are under 30
Exclusively in the preceding calendar year
questions.explanation: PEEF policy typically requires students to have completed their prior degree within a specified timeframe (usually the last 3 years) to maintain recent academic relevance.

questions.question_text: If a student has availed any other scholarship for their Master's level studies, what is the PEEF policy?
options: They can receive both scholarships simultaneously
They are ineligible for PEEF
They must return the PEEF funds later
They can receive PEEF only if the other scholarship is small
questions.explanation: PEEF scholarships are generally not provided to students who are already availing other fully funded scholarships to ensure the equitable distribution of resources.

questions.question_text: What is the maximum age limit, if applicable, for a candidate applying for the PEEF Master's scholarship?
options: 25 years
28 years
30 years
35 years
questions.explanation: The PEEF Master's level scholarship generally imposes an age limit, commonly set at 30 years at the time of application.

questions.question_text: Is a student enrolled in a distance learning or private program eligible for the PEEF Master's scholarship?
options: Yes, if they have high marks
No, only regular students are eligible
Yes, provided they pay the full fee
Only if they are government employees
questions.explanation: PEEF scholarships are exclusively reserved for students enrolled as regular full-time students in recognized institutions.

questions.question_text: Which degree level must be completed prior to applying for the PEEF Master's scholarship?
options: Matriculation
Intermediate (FA/FSc)
Bachelor's (14 or 16 years of schooling)
None, it is for fresh entrants
questions.explanation: Master's level scholarships require the completion of a Bachelor's degree (14 or 16 years of education) as the foundational qualification.

questions.question_text: Does the PEEF scholarship require the candidate to be a domicile holder of a specific region?
options: Only residents of Lahore
Only residents of Punjab province
Any Pakistani citizen residing anywhere
Residents of any province except Punjab
questions.explanation: PEEF (Punjab Educational Endowment Fund) is specifically aimed at residents/domicile holders of the Punjab province.

questions.question_text: What happens if an applicant is found to have provided false academic information in the application form?
options: The application is processed with a warning
The applicant is blacklisted from all future PEEF scholarships
The scholarship is granted with a reduction
It has no impact on the application
questions.explanation: Integrity of information is critical; providing false data results in immediate disqualification and potential permanent blacklisting.

questions.question_text: If a student has improved their marks in an exam, which marks are considered for PEEF eligibility?
options: Original marks only
Improved marks
The average of both
The marks from the first attempt only
questions.explanation: PEEF generally considers the final result appearing on the transcript or degree, which includes improved marks.

questions.question_text: If a student has previously been awarded a Master's degree, are they eligible to apply for another PEEF Master's level scholarship?
options: Yes, provided they maintain a high GPA
No, the scholarship is only for the first Master's degree
Yes, if the second degree is in a different discipline
Only if approved by the HEC
questions.explanation: PEEF policy restricts scholarships to students pursuing their first Master's degree to ensure equitable distribution of funds.

questions.question_text: What is the consequence of failing a semester during the tenure of a PEEF Master's scholarship?
options: The student continues with a warning
The scholarship is temporarily suspended
The scholarship is liable to be terminated
The student must pay a fine
questions.explanation: PEEF requires consistent academic performance; failing a semester generally leads to the termination of the scholarship.

questions.question_text: Which academic record serves as the primary basis for the eligibility review for PEEF Master's scholarships?
options: Matriculation certificate
Intermediate (FA/FSc) marks
Bachelor's degree transcripts
Entry test score only
questions.explanation: As the scholarship is for Master's level, the Bachelor's degree (graduation) academic record is the primary eligibility determinant.
